title: Factory Production Orders Guarantee Grace Period and Factory-Capacity Delays
content:
Factory-capacity delay notices shorten the on-time guarantee's grace period. For Factory Production Orders, the grace period follows the factory-capacity delay notices on the order:

- **two or more** such notices shorten it to half the class guarantee grace business days, rounded down to a whole business day;
- **exactly one** shortens it to the class guarantee grace business days less 2;
- none leaves the class guarantee grace business days.

The grace period runs in business days (Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays) starting the day after the guarantee benchmark date.

## Grace period by class (business days)

| Build class | Class grace | One factory-capacity notice | Two or more |
|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 5 | 3 | 2 |
| Custom Color Build | 5 | 3 | 2 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 7 | 5 | 3 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 7 | 5 | 3 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 10 | 8 | 5 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 10 | 8 | 5 |

Half of 5 is two and a half, rounded down to 2; half of 7 is three and a half, rounded down to 3.

## Records read

Delay notices with cause factory capacity on the order's milestone records, each counting once. Notices of other causes are not counted here.

## Hypothetical example (no federal holiday in the period)

A Specialty Glass Build order with two factory-capacity notices and a benchmark date on a Monday: the grace period of 3 business days ends on the Thursday.
